name: vizlearn
description: Interactive visual explainers for AI, ML, Algorithms and Maths.

scripts._comment_build: Tailwind purges any class it cannot find in the content globs, so `css` has to run AFTER every step that writes markup - otherwise a clean checkout builds a stylesheet missing every class the generators are about to emit, and only the second build looks right.
scripts.build: npm run sequence && npm run catalog && npm run twconfig && npm run icons && npm run og && npm run articles && npm run topics && npm run pages && npm run labs && npm run practice && npm run responsive && npm run footer && npm run moduleui && npm run seo && npm run prerender && npm run css && npm run sitemap && npm run checkjs && npm run audit
